data.raw_text: Naglagay ang Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) ng solar powered blinker sa Barangka Viaduct na matatagpuan sa boundary ng Quezon City at Marikina. Sinimulan ng MMDA Traffic Engineering Center ang pag-install ng solar powered blinker sa Barangka Viaduct noong Lunes, Nobyembre 3. Bukod dito, naglagay din ang ahensiya ng hazard markers at chevron signages kahapon upang magabayan ang mga motorista sa pakurbadang daan at mabawasan ang mga aksidente sa lugar. #mmda

data.english_translation: The Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) has installed solar powered blinker on Barangka Viaduct, located in the roundary of Quezon City and Marina. The MMDA Traffic Engineering Center began installing solar powered blinker on the Barangka Viaduct on Monday, November 3. Moreover, the hazarders and ravage signs date back to accompany motorists on the curved road and to reduce accidents in the area.
